automated.summary: All 12 required leaves executed and passed under the Node/JUnit discriminator: the testcase name must equal the leaf id verbatim AND must not be the FILE PATH, because tools/junit-run.mjs exits 0 and emits a testcase named after the file when --name matches nothing (D-0024) - so exit code alone proves nothing. Full backend hermetic suite: 201 tests, 185 pass, 0 fail, 16 skipped (the pre-existing DB-gated warehouse leaves, unchanged by this task). verify.py passes. The attestation is proven on its own terms rather than by construction: a tampered claim fails because the signature no longer matches the canonical encoding; altering the readable node metadata invalidates the context, which is the attack the metadata digest exists to stop - without it a client could forge the mapping and task 3 would render a false mapping as attested; an expired context and one issued to another user are both refused; a rotated older key still verifies while new contexts sign with the first; and constructing the provider without a secret throws, with an empty key entry rejected rather than filtered, since silently skipping one could leave the list empty and yield an unsigned context. Grounding refusals are proven at the SERVICE level, not on the Zod schema - the task grill caught that a leaf in chat.schemas.test.ts could pass while the service ignored statementGrounding entirely, so those leaves construct the service and cover a node or block outside the re-read pinned outline, a plant outside current grants, a pinned batch that fails validation, and a department or function disagreeing with the master. A separate leaf asserts a verified grounded request does NOT fall through into the LLM path, which is the boundary that keeps task 2's answer unshipped until task 2 ships it. ROUND 2 (after a review that scored security 1, performance 3, quality 4 with ten blocking findings, all of them real): the pinned-batch check validated id, source and period only while DrillBatch carries isActive, so an inactive batch passed verification. The fix is NOT the blunt rejection the lenses proposed - that would contradict decision 0025, which requires a replaced-but-present batch to be read and reported and refuses only a gone one - but a CLASSIFICATION into gone / current / replaced, so the three stop being indistinguishable and task 2 can report replacement. Two compatibility fallbacks were deleted: MisStatementService silently constructed a StatementAttestationService from the environment when a caller omitted it, which is exactly the no-development-fallback the contract forbids and a path on which a self-issued context could exist; and ChatService kept StatementGroundingService optional with an unreachable branch. Both dependencies are now required and the five fixtures that construct those services directly pass them - including all-plants-reconciliation.db.test.ts, which is DB-gated and skipped in the hermetic run, so a missing argument there would have surfaced only as a typecheck failure. The chat schema now requires node and block together rather than accepting a grounded request with no subject at all. Re-verified: 12/12 leaves still execute and pass, backend hermetic 187 pass / 0 fail / 16 pre-existing skips, verify.py green.
